related.title: Gitleaks：假密鑰樣本與洩漏處置證據
related.titleEn: Gitleaks: fake-secret fixtures and response evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件權限矩陣、最小權限YAML、無害引號測試及發布工作信任說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the event-permission matrix, least-privilege YAML, harmless quoting tests and release trust rationale.
related.difference: 區分偵測、確認、撤銷與清理；建立不輸出完整字串的報告及最小範圍例外。
related.differenceEn: Separate detection, confirmation, revocation and cleanup; produce redacted reports with narrowly scoped exceptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 最小權限縮減率=(原授權動作數−必要動作數)/原授權動作數；動作數僅是教學代理量。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 三個測試工作各被授8種動作，實際各需2種唯讀動作；發布工作另行評估。 測試工作授權由24降6，縮減18/24=75%。
處置完成率以已確認需處置項為分母；刪除檔案不等於已撤銷憑證。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成掃描有15筆發現，5筆為核准測試字串，10筆假設需處置；其中7筆有撤銷與驗證證據。 處置完成率7/10=70%，不能用7/15評估此佇列。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Permission reduction=(original actions−required actions)/original actions; action count is only a teaching proxy. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Three test jobs each receive eight action permissions but need only two read-only actions; assess release separately. Test-job grants shrink from twenty-four to six, a 75% reduction.

Response completion uses confirmed actionable findings as its denominator; deleting a file does not revoke a credential. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic scan has fifteen findings, five approved test strings and ten hypothetically actionable cases; seven have revocation and verification evidence. Completion rate=7/10=70%, not 7/15 for this queue.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kubernetes Audit：事件階段、隱私與稽核完整性
related.titleEn: Kubernetes Audit: stages, privacy and audit completeness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件權限矩陣、最小權限YAML、無害引號測試及發布工作信任說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the event-permission matrix, least-privilege YAML, harmless quoting tests and release trust rationale.
related.difference: 將請求識別、主體、資源、動詞、時間與結果連接，避免把同一請求不同stage當成多次事件。
related.differenceEn: Link request identity, subject, resource, verb, time and result without counting stages as separate requests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 最小權限縮減率=(原授權動作數−必要動作數)/原授權動作數；動作數僅是教學代理量。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 三個測試工作各被授8種動作，實際各需2種唯讀動作；發布工作另行評估。 測試工作授權由24降6，縮減18/24=75%。
請求覆蓋=至少有必要稽核證據的唯一auditID/已知請求；Metadata與RequestResponse資料暴露程度不同。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 已知100個合成請求，稽核有180列但只涵蓋90個auditID；10個請求完全缺席。 覆蓋率90/100=90%；180列不能宣稱180%覆蓋。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Permission reduction=(original actions−required actions)/original actions; action count is only a teaching proxy. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Three test jobs each receive eight action permissions but need only two read-only actions; assess release separately. Test-job grants shrink from twenty-four to six, a 75% reduction.

Request coverage counts unique auditIDs with required evidence; Metadata and RequestResponse expose different amounts of data. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. One hundred synthetic requests produce 180 audit rows covering ninety auditIDs; ten requests are absent. Coverage is 90%, not 180% merely because there are 180 rows.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
